Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.core

Interface Parser<O>

Type Parameters:
O - The output object to instantiate when the action is fired
All Known Implementing Classes:
RuleParser
public interface Parser<O>
The Parser is an interface that parses conditional expressions and action expressions. When the condition expression evaluates to true the action expression can be executed by the RulesEngine

  • Method Details

    • addImports

      Parser<O> addImports(Set<String> packages)
      This method adds package imports to the #ParserContext in order to speed up the execution of rules and simplify the rule expression. You may want to use this if many of your rules require the same packages.
      Parameters:
      packages - A set of packages to import
      Returns:
      A reference to this parser. This enables the use of the builder design pattern

    • addImport

      Parser<O> addImport(String packageString)
      This adds a single package to the #ParserContext in order to speed up the execution of rules and simplify the rule expression. Add the fully qualified name of the package as a string. You may want to use this if many of your rules require the same packages.
      Parameters:
      packageString - The package to import. Example: "java.util.Set"
      Returns:
      A reference to this parser. This enables the use of the builder design pattern

    • parseCondition

      boolean parseCondition(Serializable compiledExpression, FactStore<Object> factStore)
      Parse the condition expression and evaluate it to either a true or a false value.
      Parameters:
      compiledExpression - The serialized expression to evaluate
      factStore - A key/value store of all the facts to be evaluated by the parser
      Returns:
      A true or a false value after the condition is evaluated

    • parseAction

      O parseAction(Serializable compiledExpression, O outputResult)
      Parse the action expression that is fired by the RulesEngine and instantiate the output object type.
      Parameters:
      compiledExpression - The serialized expression to evaluate
      outputResult - The output object
      Returns:
      The output object that is instantiated when the action is fired
